audit.evidence: **Share an abstract-level database over the network or other kind of stream.** The successor to `multileveldown`. If you are upgrading, please see UPGRADING.md. ／ Use this module to share an `abstract-level` database across multiple processes or machines. A _host_ exposes a database of choice over binary streams, using compact Protocol Buffers messages to encode database operations. One or more _guests_ connect to that host and expose it as an `abstract-level` database, as if it is a regular, local database. They can opt-in to a seamless retry in order to reconnect to a host without aborting any pending database operations. ／ Create a guest database that reads and writes to the host's database. The `ManyLevelGuest` class extends `AbstractLevel` and thus follows the public API of `abstract-level` with a few additional methods and one additional constructor option. As such, the majority of the API is documented in `abstract-level`. It supports sublevels, `iterator.seek()` and every other `abstract-level` feature, except for the `createIfMissing` and `errorIfExists` options which have no effect here. Iterators have built-in end-to-end backpressure regardless of the transport that you use.

audit.evidence: Soup.net is shared memory for AI agents. The agents you work with record your judgment calls as they happen, then bring them back in your next session, on a different tool, or to a collaborator's agent joining the project. The recipe book builds itself. ／ - **Self-host** — MIT-licensed, deliberately boring stack (Postgres 17 + pgvector, Hono, React). No LLM runs on the server for the core check path: agents do the reasoning wherever they already run; the server does storage and vector search. (Optional premium features — off by default, opt-in per user — use one server-side LLM call; see `docs/planning/premium-llm-features.md`.) Embeddings default to Google's Gemini API (an AI Studio key works; a deterministic stub provider covers dev and tests with zero API calls), but self-hosters can run them **fully locally with no key** — in-process on CPU, or against any local `/v1/embeddings` server (Local / offline embeddings below). Gemini is then needed only for the optional premium features. Quick start below. Either way your corpus exports as a single JSON file (`GET /auth/me/export`, signed in) — and imports back: `POST /import` accepts that same file as the raw request body (signed-in humans only), so a corpus can move between instances, restore from backup, or rebuild into a fresh recipe book. By default import creates a new recipe book (name it with `?book_name=`); pass `?book=<slug|id>` to import into an existing one. Re-importing your own corpus is idempotent (exact-id upsert — re-uploading skips what already landed); importing a corpus whose ids belong to someone else on the instance mints fresh ids and reports the old→new mapping, so it's a portability tool, not a byte-identical restore (a row can even arrive without an id and still import). Import re-embeds asynchronously through the content-addressed vector cache, so text the instance has embedded before costs zero provider calls — and deleting an account preserves that shared cache, so re-provisioning the same corpus stays free. ／ docker compose up --build -d    # postgres + backend (with in-process embedding worker) + mailpit

identity.one_liner: AI 原生数据应用开发框架，含 AWEL 工作流与 Agents
identity.review: DB-GPT 是用于构建数据应用的开源 AI 框架，提供 RAG、Text2SQL 微调、多模型管理（SMMF）、多 Agent 协作与 AWEL 工作流编排等能力，支持通过自然语言与数据库、数据仓库、Excel 等数据源交互并生成分析报告，供企业开发者搭建知识问答与生成式 BI 类应用，支持 Docker、源码等方式安装，采用 MIT 许可证。
highlights: 提供 RAG 框架与 GraphRAG，用于构建知识库问答应用
提供 Text2SQL 自动微调框架（SFT/LoRA/QLoRA），基于 AWEL 实现工作流编排
提供服务化多模型管理框架（SMMF），支持多种开源与 API 大模型
use_cases: 基于私有数据构建 RAG 知识问答应用
自然语言查询数据库并生成分析报表（GBI）
Text2SQL 模型微调与数据驱动的多 Agent 应用开发

classification.eco_why: README 定位为面向数据应用开发的框架，提供连接数据源、Text2SQL、RAG 等为数据交互服务的能力，而非仅使用数据库的应用

audit.evidence: 🤖 **DB-GPT is an open source AI native data app development framework with AWEL(Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and agents**. ／ The purpose is to build infrastructure in the field of large models, through the development of multiple technical capabilities such as multi-model management (SMMF), Text2SQL effect optimization, RAG framework and optimization, Multi-Agents framework collaboration, AWEL (agent workflow orchestration), etc. Which makes large model applications with data simpler and more convenient. ／  The DB-GPT project facilitates seamless natural language interaction with diverse data sources, including Excel, databases, and data warehouses. It simplifies the process of querying and retrieving information from these sources, empowering users to engage in intuitive conversations and gain insights. Moreover, DB-GPT supports the generation of analytical reports, providing users with valuable data summaries and interpretations.

identity.one_liner: 自托管的 AI 代理共享记忆服务器，基于 PostgreSQL+pgvector，经 MCP 提供记忆读写
identity.review: Kenfold 是一个自托管记忆服务器，让 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、ChatGPT 等多个 AI 代理通过 MCP 共享同一份记忆。它将记忆分类为语义、情景、项目、偏好等类型并保留历史版本，数据存于 PostgreSQL+pgvector；提供 API key 归属、会话钩子自动记录、本地模型嵌入与检索、记忆抽取人工审核等机制，支持 Docker Compose 部署，也支持 stdio 方式直连数据库。适合希望多个 AI 编码代理之间延续上下文的个人开发者或团队。
highlights: 通过 MCP 向多个 AI 代理提供共享记忆，每条记忆记录来源代理与信任度，替换时保留历史
支持全文检索与本地嵌入模型（bge-m3）+ 重排序的混合检索，记忆抽取与合并需人工审核后生效
提供会话钩子自动加载/记录记忆，并基于代码引用将过期记忆标记为 stale
use_cases: 多个 AI 编码代理（Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode 等）之间共享项目上下文与交接工作
自托管场景下对代理记忆进行审核、合并与过期管理
为本地模型/远程客户端（ChatGPT、claude.ai）提供经 OAuth 2.1 鉴权的记忆服务

identity.review: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 AI 记忆插件，也可通过 npm 安装后接入 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor 或独立浏览器使用。它把每轮对话压缩沉淀为知识卡，新卡默认进入审核中心，人工批准后才入主库；数据用 SQLite（node:sqlite）持久存储于 ~/.dsh/memory-vault，并支持 Markdown、知识图谱展示与多库隔离。提供 MCP 挂载与 memory_recall 检索工具。
highlights: 支持对话结束自动沉淀知识卡与 memory_recall 检索，并通过 MCP 接入 Claude Code/Codex/Cursor
提供审核中心与数据库层审核守卫（enforceAudit），未审核卡物理隔离于 quarantine 表
使用 SQLite（node:sqlite 内置）持久存储，含知识图谱、去重与多库配置
use_cases: 为 DSH/Claude Code/Codex/Cursor 等 Agent 提供跨会话持久记忆
团队或个人对 AI 记忆入库进行人工审核与审计追溯
本地维护可检索的知识卡库与知识图谱
